subject: Request: temporary overrun coverage and invoice reconciliation
messages:
From: Samir Khan <samir.khan@shopwise.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@shopwise.com
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary overrun coverage and invoice reconciliation

Hi Sofia,

Quick one — we had a pretty big spike in inference traffic last month tied to an unplanned A/B rollout and received an overrun invoice for $24,700 (see attached usage_report_apr.pdf). We have a go-live for a new marketing-driven feature the week of May 3, and the team is nervous about hitting similar spikes.

Can Redwood help with a short-term buffer for that launch window and also help reconcile the April overrun? Ideally we would: 
- Get a temporary headroom / buffer for May 3–10 so the feature can ship without throttling.
- Discuss an amortized credit or true-up for the April overrun — a full credit is unlikely but we need a path that smooths the billing impact across May.

Procurement copied here — they will need a formal quote or PO line if we agree. Let me know what options you can offer quickly (we need to finalize the launch plan by EOD Friday).

Thanks,
Samir Khan
Head of ML Ops, ShopWise
samir.khan@shopwise.com

Attachment: usage_report_apr.pdf (summary CSV + token breakdown)

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Khan <samir.khan@shopwise.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary overrun coverage and invoice reconciliation

Hi Samir — thanks for the heads up and for sharing the report. We can definitely help protect the launch while also addressing the April invoice. Two immediate paths that are operationally simple: 

1) Coverage band (recommended, fast):
- Monthly retainer: $5,000 for a 2-week launch window (we pro-rate)
- Includes up to 250,000 extra tokens at a blended surcharge of $0.012/token for that window
- Any usage beyond the band billed at your standard pay-as-you-go rate; if you convert to a 12‑month reserved commitment within 60 days, we will apply a 20% credit to the April overrun (applied as a one-time invoice adjustment).

2) One-off credit + PO:
- We can offer a discretionary amortized credit of up to 30% on the $24,700 overrun, split across the next two invoices, contingent on a signed PO for the launch buffer.

Operational asks from our side:
- Procurement PO for the agreed option (so finance can issue an invoice memo)
- Billing contact for where to send the amended invoice/credit memo

I attached a short proposal stub (sofia_proposal_cover_terms.pdf) — I can have Ben draft the pricing sheet if you like. Which option would you prefer? If you want something more aggressive (higher token cap / lower uplift), ping Ben and we’ll see what we can do.

Best,
Sofia
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai

Attachment: sofia_proposal_cover_terms.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Khan <samir.khan@shopwise.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary overrun coverage and invoice reconciliation

Samir — quick addition from pricing: we have a tight, low-friction option we call the "Launch Protector":

- One-time uplift fee: $3,000 (covers administrative + priority capacity)
- 14-day protection window starting on go-live, includes up to 500,000 additional tokens
- Flat overrun rate during the window: $0.015/token beyond the 500k cap
- If you sign a 6- or 12-month SOW within 45 days, we will reduce the uplift fee by 50% (so $1,500 credit applied to the next invoice).

This avoids invoicing complexity (single uplift charge + clear overage band) and gets procurement a single line item. I attached a quick pricing sheet (launch_protector_pricing.xlsx).

If ShopWise prefers the lower steady retainer Sofia suggested, we can seat that too — happy to model both.

Cheers,
Ben
Head of Commercials, Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary overrun coverage and invoice reconciliation

Looping in a couple of internal items we need before we finalize anything: 

- Legal/contract: we need a simple amendment (SOW addendum) for the Launch Protector or Coverage Band. Include start/end dates, billing schedule, and confirmation this is not a contract change to core SLA.
- Finance: require explicit PO number or procurement email for any invoice changes; revenue recognition needs a memo if we apply a retrospective credit.
- Compliance: no special data handling changes here, but confirm that the launch capacity will use the same model variants and no cross-account routing.

Do not apply any discretionary credits until procurement provides the PO. Also, Ben — please add a short invoice memo we can attach to the April billing record if we go with the amortized credit path.

Thanks — once we have a preferred option from Samir I’ll fast-track the amendment template.

— Lauren
Senior Legal Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Samir Khan <samir.khan@shopwise.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@shopwise.com
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2026 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary overrun coverage and invoice reconciliation

Thanks team — appreciate the fast options. We discussed internally and want to accept the Launch Protector to keep the billing simple and avoid multiple credits. Two asks before you proceed: 
1) Can the uplift be $2,500 instead of $3,000? Our budget owner is pushing back on the extra $500.
2) Please include a short line on the invoice: "April overrun reconciled — amortized protection fee for May launch (see SOW addendum SW-2026-0427)." Procurement will issue a PO for the accepted uplift once we have the amendment text.

If you can confirm the $2,500 uplift and send the amendment I’ll route the PO today.

Samir
Head of ML Ops, ShopWise
